question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting or backporting the legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or treat that helper as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through Skill Workshop?
rationale: Automation can verify the released parser behavior and the linked fix candidate, but current main removed the helper and current docs/instructions point to Skill Workshop as the durable creation surface.

options.title: Keep Skill Workshop-only on main
options.body: Confirm the helper is obsolete on current main, then close or supersede the linked PR and only consider a release-branch backport if maintainers want to support released helper users.

options.title: Refresh or backport the helper fix
options.body: Sponsor a targeted PR or release-branch backport that normalizes resource tokens and preserves focused tests without restoring obsolete skill scaffolding guidance on main.

recommendation.title: Keep Skill Workshop-only on main
recommendation.body: Confirm the helper is obsolete on current main, then close or supersede the linked PR and only consider a release-branch backport if maintainers want to support released helper users.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current-main skill-creator rewrite that removed the helper and also carried the latest release snapshot that still contains it.
